characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: DIL 805A dilatometer (TA Instruments, New Castle, DE, USA)
characterization_methods.key_findings: Ms = 274 °C for S2 (after 1150 °C austenitization); at TB = 300 °C the bainitic transformation completed in 3600 s with an incubation time of 130 s.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Cylindrical specimens ∅5x10 mm³; heating/cooling cycles of Fig. 1(a)
characterization_methods.purpose: Determination of austenitizing response, Ms (tangent-intersection method), bainitic transformation finish time Bt and transformation kinetics

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Carl Zeiss AG, Jena, Germany; samples etched with 6% Nital
characterization_methods.key_findings: S2 is αp-free at both the 1050 °C benchmark and the selected TA of 1150 °C.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: LOM at 1050 °C benchmark (200×) and at selected TA of 1150 °C
characterization_methods.purpose: Verification of polygonal ferrite (αp) content at the applied austenitizing temperature

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Carl Zeiss AG SEM (gold sputter coated); EDX (Oxford Instruments, Abingdon, UK)
characterization_methods.key_findings: S2 at 300 °C shows a fine lath/needle bainitic matrix annotated 'Spec.3 + (Fe,M)xCy' (200 nm scale bar); Lt(t) = 34 nm for S2 at TA 1150 °C/TB 300 °C.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Bainite thickness from 100 measurements across 10 SEM images per specimen (ImageJ, stereological correction Lt(t) = 2Lt/π)
characterization_methods.purpose: Microstructural/lamellar thickness measurement and precipitate (carbide) identification
characterization_methods.technique: Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX)

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Carl Zeiss SEM with Oxford Instruments EBSD system and software
characterization_methods.key_findings: General method applied to the steels (EBSD maps primarily reported for S5).
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Accelerating voltage 20 kV, step size 0.2 μm; electropolished and vibratory polished surfaces
characterization_methods.purpose: Microstructural feature mapping and local misorientation (KAM) analysis

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Malvern Panalytical Empyrean diffractometer, Cu X-ray tube, 40 kV/40 mA, PIXcel 1D detector
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Cu Kα radiation, 40 kV; Vγ determined per ASTM E975-13 using integrated intensities
characterization_methods.purpose: Determination of retained austenite volume fraction (Vγ) and phase micro-strains (εγ, εα)

interfaces.interface_notes: S2 is αp-free at the applied TA of 1150 °C; αp is absent so no αp–austenite interfaces are present (unlike S3).
interfaces.phase_evolution: Austenitized at 1150 °C (15 min), cooled at 100 K s⁻¹ to TB = 300 °C, then isothermally austempered for Bt = 3600 s after an incubation of 130 s to complete bainitic transformation; retained austenite of 29% remains (incomplete reaction). (Fe,M)xCy precipitates form during cooling (estimated between ~700–1150 °C for S1/S3 with S1 also approximately representative of S2).

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: Bainitic transformation finish time (Bt) at TB = 300 °C
UTS/El/PSE at TB = 300 °C (S2: 1590 MPa, 7.0%, PSE 11,130 MPa·% vs S1: 1600 MPa, 6.8%, PSE 10,880 MPa·%)

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Steel blocks were cast via vacuum arc furnace.
Homogenization promotes uniform composition and microstructure throughout the steel blocks.
Homogenized steel subjected to step-by-step hot rolling to ~11 mm followed by slow cooling in the oven.

processing_steps.method: water jet cutting (OMAX 2626, Kent, Washington, USA)
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Samples fabricated using a water jet cutting machine to allow accurate geometries and minimize thermal distortion; cylindrical specimens (∅5x10 mm^3) used for heat treatment.
TA = 1150 °C for 15 min applied to S1, S2, S4 and S5 to reach an αp-free microstructure; heating rate 10 K s⁻¹. TA applied above calculated (929 °C) and measured (1031 °C) values for S2.

processing_steps.method: cooling from austenitization to austempering temperature
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Cooling rate from austenitization to austempering temperature is 100 K s⁻¹, fast enough to suppress intermediate phase transformations.
Austempering at TB = 300 °C held to bainitic transformation finish Bt = 3600 s for S2; incubation time 130 s. Followed by final cooling.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Tensile tests on a Zwick/Roell universal testing machine (250 kN load cell); specimens heat-treated in DIL 805A dilatometer applying the thermal cycle of Fig. 1(a).
measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: ASTM E8 sub-size round specimens (12.5 mm gauge length, 2.5 mm diameter, 7 mm shoulder length)

phases_present.morphology: rounded, nucleation-driven particles located near γr–bainitic ferrite phase boundaries
phases_present.phase_name: (Fe,M)xCy carbide (cementite-like, modified by Si and Mo)

precipitates.distribution: near γr–bainitic ferrite phase boundaries; observed by SEM for S1, S2 and S3

structures.overall_structure: αp-free nano-bainitic (nB) microstructure composed of fine bainitic ferrite laths with retained austenite and (Fe,M)xCy carbides; S2 is αp-free both at the 1050 °C benchmark and at the applied TA of 1150 °C.
